However, MarioKart8Deluxe_Expert incorrectly concluded that the world record time closest to June 7, 2023, was 1:48.585 by Pii. This oversight led to the failure to identify the correct world record time, which was 1:41.614. They did not sufficiently verify the track or consult accurate sources to confirm the correct record time.
